name: مدار
subtitle: للصلاة والقرآن ويومك
promotionalText: مساحة عربية تجمع الصلاة والقرآن والمذكرات والعادات والمال والقراءة، مع حفظ بياناتك محليًا على جهازك.
description:
مدار مساحة ليومك، من أول صلاة إلى آخر سطر.

الصلاة: أوقات الصلاة، والتسجيل والتراجع، والقضاء والسفر.
القرآن: خطة للحفظ والمراجعة، ومتابعة جلساتك وموضعك.
المذكرات: أيامك وخواطرك وصورك وتسجيلاتك، مع البحث والتصدير.
العادات: متابعة ما تكرره، وقراءة تقدّمك من سجلاتك الفعلية.
المال: حساباتك ومصاريفك ومظاريفك والتزاماتك، وحساب تقريبي للزكاة وفق الخيارات التي تحددها. أسعار الصرف والمعادن تدخلها يدويًا.
المحبرة: مكتبتك الورقية والرقمية، وقارئ EPUB وPDF، وبحث محلي في النص والصور باستخدام التعرّف الضوئي.

واجهة عربية من اليمين إلى اليسار، وتواريخ هجرية وميلادية، وودجات واختصارات للوصول إلى غرفك.

لا تحتاج سجلاتك إلى حساب مدار. تحفظ النسخة الحالية بياناتك محليًا على جهازك ولا تتضمن مزامنة iCloud. بعض الخدمات الاختيارية تحتاج إلى الإنترنت، مثل تنزيل الكتب والتحويل الصوتي عبر Apple بعد موافقتك. التعرّف الضوئي قد يخطئ، فتبقى صورة الصفحة مرجعك. حساب الزكاة تقديري ولا يثبت تحقق شروط الوجوب في حالتك.
reviewNotes: The current v1 build is local-only; no Madar account, developer-operated records backend, or CloudKit sync is included. On first launch, choose a city and complete onboarding. Face ID is an optional app-level biometric gate; it has no passcode fallback. Widgets and Controls read app-written snapshots; extensions do not open the SwiftData store. HealthKit is optional and read-only for walking totals. Bank messages arrive only via user-initiated paste or a configured Shortcut; the app does not read the Messages database. Metal prices and exchange rates are manual. The Zakat screen labels results as approximate, asks for the nisab/debt method and shows source links. On-device Vision OCR operates on PDF image pages without modifying the original file; OCR text exists only while its search sheet is open. Downloaded Turath books read locally after import. Optional Apple server speech recognition requires separate in-app consent; on-device routes are preferred. Only after a user taps the Quran source-search link, up to the first 12 normalized Arabic words of that ayah go directly to shamela.ws; no Madar server receives the query and Shamela retention is unknown. Spotlight is optional, off by default, and indexes book titles only. No advertising, tracking SDK or developer analytics is integrated. iOS 27-only widget families are hidden on iOS 26.

localOnlyData: financial records and pasted bank messages
book files and on-device OCR text
location used to calculate prayer times

appleServerSpeechAfterConsent.note: Do not submit a blanket Data Not Collected response while this optional server route ships. Apple handles its own retention under its speech privacy notice.

privacyLabelPreparation.turathNetwork: Catalogue searches run locally. Download requests expose the requested public book ID and ordinary connection metadata, including IP address, to files.turath.io and its hosting provider. No diary, financial record, book annotation or local search query is uploaded. Provider retention was not established; do not claim anonymous networking or confirmed zero retention.
privacyLabelPreparation.shamelaVerseSearch: Only after the user taps the source-search link, up to the first 12 normalized Arabic words of the selected Quran ayah are sent in a query directly to shamela.ws by the browser. No Madar server receives it. Shamela query retention was not established; the privacy policy makes no zero-retention claim.
privacyLabelPreparation.localOnlyDataAppliesTo: Describes the current local-only v1 release; CloudKit sync is deferred and is not part of this build.
privacyLabelPreparation.developerOperatedCollectionNote: No Madar-operated records backend or CloudKit sync is included in the current build. Assess optional Apple server speech and the Turath download connection separately.

cloudKitSync.availability: Deferred; excluded from current v1 under RA1 until the owner explicitly reopens CloudKit.

privacyLabelPreparation.appPrivacyLabelStatus: Pending review for the exact local-only release build; assess optional Apple server speech, Turath download networking, user-initiated Shamela verse searches and HealthKit separately. Do not declare persistent CloudKit data.

publicationInputsStillRequired: A public HTTPS URL for privacy.html and a real support destination; no address or domain has been invented.
App Store Connect account access, distribution signing and review contact details.
Owner and Claude's full-screen comparison captures and later real-device checks.
Confirm third-party network retention disclosures against providers' published policies before submitting the privacy label; Shamela search retention is currently unknown.
Review App Privacy categories and purposes against the exact local-only release build, including optional Apple server speech, HealthKit, Turath downloads and user-initiated Shamela verse searches.
CloudKit sync and its deletion control are deferred under RA1; exclude them from this release and revisit only after explicit owner direction.
